about: Recording batch E3c of ADR 0012, FX errors: the catalogue cases of FX-12 to FX-15 and FX-30 to FX-38 (FX-36's executor part only) and of FX-V6, with FX-10/a, which also needs a failure module. Each case is recorded on the CE oracle by a run of the fixtures below, or deferred with a milestone and a reason. FX-14/c is recorded by milestone N5's fixture flows/control-flow/subflow-retry, outside this batch, and FX-30/b and FX-38/b, which the reference added in its revision SC4, are requested from batch E3f. TestRecordingBatches enforces it.

deferred.reason: source-derived in the reference's revision of 2026-10-29 (SC3): a mock value carrying a string wm_failure fails the step's identity job, so b never runs; no run of this batch records it, and docs/design/README.md requests the recording from a future batch E3f (wm_failure on identity jobs). windmill-lite's identity job, a mocked step's included, succeeds today whatever its result holds (internal/engine, identityJob), while N1b applies wm_failure to a script's result only, so a follow-up of N1b implements it

source-derived in the reference's revision of 2026-10-29 (SC3): a tolerated wm_failure result reaches the next identity job, or a step its true skip_if skips, as previous_result and fails it, so c never runs; no run of this batch records it, and docs/design/README.md requests the recording from a future batch E3f (wm_failure on identity jobs). windmill-lite's identity job succeeds today whatever its result holds (internal/engine, identityJob), so a follow-up of N1b, which owns wm_failure and continue_on_error, implements it

oracle-observed in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), from a fixture outside this batch: milestone N5's flows/control-flow/subflow-retry run pre_run (oracle run 40926159329) records it, the same run as CF-17/f; no run of this batch records it. A flow step's input transform throws, so its subflow job fails without running, and the step's retry runs the subflow with {}. N5's gate runs that fixture on windmill-lite (cmd/wltest TestSubflowRetryFixturesFreshAndWarm)

source-derived in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a container's own settings on handled failures and forwarded stops, item 5). At the last module a due retry runs before continue_on_error tolerates the failure: a runs three times, the flow succeeds with the wrapped error, and a's Failure status lists the two earlier attempts. N2 added retries to N1b's continue_on_error

source-derived in the reference's revision SC4 (2026-10-29), and no run of this batch records it; docs/design/README.md requests the recording from batch E3f (a step canceled while it waits to start). A cancellation reaches a step whose job still waits on the preceding step's sleep: the job, a subflow's (kind flow) or a script's, completes failed with the Canceled error at its pickup, with no child job and nothing run. N2 schedules the sleep's wait, and the subflow variant needs N3c's subflow by path
